2608.21249.title: Benchmarking Patent Drafting from Inventor-Style Disclosures
2608.21249.paper_summary: While recent large language models (LLMs) have achieved promising results on individual patent drafting tasks, they fundamentally fail to investigate the core challenge of real-world patent drafting: generating a complete and legally coherent patent application directly from early-stage invention materials. Prior work predominantly assumes later-stage, highly structured, or already legalistic inputs. However, real patenting workflows begin with informal, de-legalized disclosures authored by inventors. To bridge the gap, we introduce Dis2Pat, a disclosure-to-patent dataset that reflects realistic patenting workflows by requiring the generation of complete patent applications directly from inventor-style, de-legalized disclosures. Given the inherent difficulty of long-form, legally constrained patent drafting and the strong privacy requirements, we further propose a strong baseline named Patent-MAF. It is a multi-agent framework for locally deployable patent drafting. Benchmark results reveal that current LLMs exhibit limitations in patent drafting, while Patent-MAF provides a strong baseline that consistently outperforms evaluated open-source models and remains competitive with large closed-source models.
2608.21249.paper_summary_zh: 雖然最近的大型語言模型（LLMs）在單個專利撰寫任務上取得了可喜的成果，但它們根本上未能調查現實世界專利撰寫的核心挑戰：直接從早期發明材料生成完整且法律上連貫的專利申請。先前的工作主要假設後期、高度結構化或已經法律化的輸入。然而，真實的專利工作流程始於由發明人撰寫的非正式、去法律化的披露。為了填補這一差距，我們引入了Dis2Pat，一個從披露到專利的數據集，通過要求直接從發明者風格的去法律化披露生成完整的專利申請，反映了現實的專利工作流程。考慮到長格式、法律約束的專利撰寫固有的困難以及強烈的隱私要求，我們進一步提出了一個名為Patent-MAF的強基準。這是一個可在本地部署的多代理專利撰寫框架。基準結果顯示，當前的LLMs在專利撰寫方面存在局限性，而Patent-MAF提供了一個強基準，始終超越評估的開源模型，並與大型封閉源模型保持競爭力。
